d: A native PC port of Super Mario Strikers, ported from decompiled code.
ld: An unofficial port of Super Mario Strikers / Mario Smash Football for PlayStation Vita. The current runtime uses VitaGL, PC-prepared native graphics, PCM audio, and H.264/AAC MP4 movies streamed from PSARC through SceAvPlayer. This project is still under development. Since version 1.4, live gameplay runs at about 58-59 FPS on a retail Vita in The Palace and about 48 FPS in Pipeline Central (measured at 444/222 MHz with vsync, in a test match), up from about 16-20 FPS. Stadium intros and replays are presented at an even 30 FPS by design. Stable 60 FPS in every scene is not certified yet.
